userConstraints: BTC and ETH are mandatory members of every eligible basket
Use public or free historical data before requesting paid acquisition
Directional price prediction is the primary research objective
This phase must not wait for future wall-clock observations
designConventions: Prior thirty-day notional ranks assets only to bound liquidity and data quality
Basket sizes and horizons are bounded search dimensions rather than presumed optima
Forecast evidence is evaluated before execution or portfolio claims
Every attempted configuration remains in the immutable trial ledger
empiricalClaims: BTC may or may not improve forecasts beyond alternative market factors
Divergence may continue, reverse, or contain no stable information
No estimator family or forecast horizon is presumed superior
A richer information set may fail to improve the strongest market-only baseline

searchBudget.budgetUnit: one exact model configuration and seed; every fold-level fit is counted inside the trial ledger entry

validation.method: purged chronological expanding-window development scoring followed by one untouched single-use family confirmation
validation.multiplicity: Holm over the complete frozen confirmation family

developmentPeriod.purpose: archive-backed purged development scoring and bounded selection

confirmation.purpose: sealed archive confirmation with sufficient coverage for the seven-day horizon
